_**Agent (claude-opus-4-6 2026-04-15 12:35:38Z)**_

Found it. In YAML folded scalars (`>-`), backslashes are literal, so `\\.` becomes two backslashes instead of one. The regex needs single `\.` inside folded scalars.

_**Agent (claude-opus-4-6 2026-04-15 12:36:48Z)**_

Deployed copy already has the fix (chezmoi syncs them). The root cause: YAML folded scalars (`>-`) treat backslashes literally, so `\\.` ended up as two literal backslashes in the regex (matching `\\`), not an escaped dot. Changed to `\.` on line 1512-1513 of `dot_ansible/roles/devtools/tasks/main.yml`. Re-run `chezmoi apply` (or the ansible play) and the television install will proceed.
